description: Fetch one URL with conditional GET; extract, date, score, classify listing-vs-article AND source type; blobstore the text; queue discovered links deduped and depth-capped. 5.0.2 stops the link-spool counters from overwriting the detected sourceType.
name: Scout Fetch

description: Insights are now REPLACED per run instead of accumulating; diagnostics over articles only.
name: Scout Health

description: Index the OWNER'S own published articles from their sitemap (urls + lastmod only, never page bodies). Writes solely to p-scout-owned so the owner's content can never enter the findings corpus.
name: Scout Owned Inventory

description: Keep watching: re-queue every known source host's root + its busiest article sections into the frontier. Conditional GETs make unchanged pages a 304; only genuinely new links survive dedupe. Honours brief.denyHosts; capped per run.
name: Scout Recrawl

description: Widen the crawl via a search API (brave|tavily|serper, whichever key is present). Emits frontierCandidates at depth 0, deduped against the registry and filtered by the brief's denyHosts. Key via $SEARCH_API_KEY, never in a token.
name: Scout Search

description: Onboard a website by harvesting its own index: discover the sitemap (robots.txt Sitemap: lines, then conventional locations), walk index files to the article lists, filter non-articles, drop everything the registry knows, queue the rest into the frontier. Consumes p-scout-source-requests onboarding asks. Bounded per run (150/host, 300 total by default) — repeat runs are incremental via the registry.
name: Scout Sitemap Harvest

description: Deterministic rollup + expansion tracking: re-buckets findings by current age FIRST, rolls counts by category and SOURCE TYPE, maintains per-host source profiles (p-scout-sources), appends a growth snapshot (p-scout-growth), joins own inventory for trueGaps, and withholds the facts token when the corpus is unchanged and the analysis is fresh — no model call for zero new information.
name: Scout Taxonomy

description: Draft ONE accepted article task with the local claude binary: deterministic prep, headless claude, markdown stored in the blobstore and filed as a revisioned draft token. Env TASK_ID drafts a named task (always writes); WRITER_MODEL picks the claude model alias.
name: Scout Write (Claude Code)

description: The same staff writer, driven by the dashboard for ONE named task and a named model: the lane passes TASK_ID and WRITER_MODEL, so a human can ask a specific model to draft a specific assignment. On demand only — nothing schedules it. Blob-backed and revisioned, so the earlier draft survives for comparison.
name: Scout Write (named model, on demand)
